gesstabs.diagnostics.enabled.description: Flag documented GESStabs pitfalls (empty varlist, unmatched #MACRO/#IFDEF blocks, duplicate declarations, inverted RECODE bounds, CARD/CARDS ordering, WEIGHTCELLS percentages, CELLSET element allow-list, INVERTOUT+UPDATEINVERT, #define/#ifdef case mismatches).

gesstabs.debugMode.description: Enable debug messages in the console.

gesstabs.hover.enabled.description: Master switch for all GESStabs hovers (macro-call expansion and #EXPAND value hovers). Disable to turn off hovers entirely regardless of the per-kind settings below.

gesstabs.hover.macros.description: Show the expanded macro body when hovering a #name(...) macro call. Has no effect if gesstabs.hover.enabled is false.

gesstabs.hover.expands.description: Show the defined value when hovering a bare #name that refers to a "#EXPAND #name value" definition. Has no effect if gesstabs.hover.enabled is false.

gesstabs.hover.keywords.description: Show syntax + description for the GESStabs keyword under the cursor. Has no effect if gesstabs.hover.enabled is false.

enumDescriptions: Use VS Code's own display language (German if it starts with "de", English otherwise).
gesstabs.hover.language.description: Which manual's descriptions to show for GESStabs keyword hover/autocomplete. If a keyword is only documented in the other language, that one is shown instead of nothing.

gesstabs.autocomplete.enabled.description: Suggest GESStabs keywords, previously-defined variable/table names, and macro names while typing.

gesstabs.hover.effectiveElements.description: Show the effective CELLELEMENTS/FRAMEELEMENTS defaults when hovering a TABLE/OVERVIEW/XOVERVIEW statement. Has no effect if gesstabs.hover.enabled is false.

enumDescriptions: Hide blank lines and comment-only lines from the macro's original source when showing its expanded body.
Show the expanded body exactly as the macro's source is written, including blank lines and comments.
gesstabs.hover.macroExpansionStyle.description: How much of the macro's original formatting to preserve in the "Expanded #name(...)" hover.
